case_label: Sourced asset bands, encumbrance and business costs
starting_deposit_cost: Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy
deposit_beta_policy: Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
operating_cost_policy: Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
credit_cost_policy: Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
excluded_income_note: Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
comparison_note: The original aggregate, no-business-cost case remains a separately labeled reference. This extended case does not retrospectively overwrite its results.
